notes: Copy marks from an enlarged plan onto an overall plan drawn at a different scale.

features: Scale to sheet: select marks on a plan at one drawing scale and copy them onto a sheet at another, for example from a 1/4 inch enlarged plan to the 3/16 inch overall plan. Pick the two scales while the marks are on the drawing, watch them resize, then drag them into position and place. The spacing between marks scales with them, so a run of devices stays in the right rooms. Nothing has to be calibrated in advance.
